name: ASTRO
recent: Astro 于 2026 年 10 月 23 日宣布，其全资子公司 MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems 拟以最高 8300 万令吉现金向 Maxis Broadband 出售宽带业务资产。同期公司出现多项董事及委员会人事变动。最新季度（截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日）营收同比下滑 7.2%，并录得净亏损。
notable: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems 拟以最高 8300 万令吉现金向 Maxis Broadband 出售宽带业务资产。
公司出现多项董事及委员会人事变动，包括 Renzo Christopher Viegas 的董事会、审计委员会及提名与薪酬委员会变动。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 2580 万令吉，净利率为 -4.1%，而上一季度净利率为 0.2%。
营收同比下滑 7.2%，环比下滑 3.9%。
净亏损同比扩大 257.3%，环比扩大 1712.5%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度，营收为 6.338 亿令吉，同比下滑 7.2%，环比下滑 3.9%；净亏损 2580 万令吉，净利率 -4.1%，而上一季度净利率为 0.2%。净亏损同比扩大 257.3%，环比扩大 1712.5%。

recent_en: On 23 October 2026, Astro announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems proposed to dispose of its broadband business assets to Maxis Broadband for up to RM83.0 million cash. Several board and committee changes also took place during the period. In the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue fell 7.2% year-on-year and the company recorded a net loss.
notable_en: MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems proposed to dispose of its broadband business assets to Maxis Broadband for up to RM83.0 million cash.
Several board and committee changes occurred, including changes involving Renzo Christopher Viegas on the Board, Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
risks_en: The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM25.8 million with a net margin of -4.1%, compared with a net margin of 0.2% in the previous quarter.
Net loss widened 257.3% year-on-year and 1712.5% quarter-on-quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM633.8 million, down 7.2% year-on-year and 3.9% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was RM25.8 million with a net margin of -4.1%, versus a net margin of 0.2% in the previous quarter. Net loss widened 257.3% year-on-year and 1712.5% quarter-on-quarter.
